_comment: Connector-specific edits to GENERATED/authored files that a cli-printing-press reprint must NOT clobber. check_handfixes.py asserts every marker below is still present and fails CI if a reprint dropped one. Provenance: project_onboard_missing_required_positional_defect.md (PR #75, 2026-06-07, Gradient MSP billing sync).

handfixes.summary: Doc examples/Command-Reference rows keep their REQUIRED positional (billing <serviceId>, services get <serviceId>, mappings update <serviceId>, accounts update-one <accountId>); the press dropped them for some commands
handfixes.why: The press inconsistently annotates required positionals: in the SAME Command Reference it wrote `billing <serviceId>` for some commands but dropped the positional for siblings (accounts update-one, mappings update, services get) even though all require one (Usage: ... <foo> [flags]). check_cli_claims is blind (it parses the first bareword as the subcommand and ignores trailing positionals), so a non-runnable example sails through every mechanical gate - only iterated adversarial review caught it. A reprint reverts the examples to the no-positional form (e.g. `gradient-cli billing --account-id ...` which errors 'serviceId is required', exit 2).
handfixes.spec_encode_followup: Fix belongs in the press doc generator: emit required positionals consistently in every Command-Reference row + runnable example. Tracked in project_onboard_missing_required_positional_defect.

handfixes.summary: Governance Write tier hand-promoted to include the 5 verb-less writes (usage push, billing, alert send, alerting, import) the keyword classifier missed; 14 total
handfixes.why: gen_governance keyed on write-verb keywords, so the 5 verb-less / non-standard-verb POSTs (usage push, billing, alert send, alerting, import) fell to the Read tier. Hand-authored governance.md Write tier names all 14 mutations (union, not replace). A reprint regenerates governance.md from the blind classifier and silently demotes the 5 to Read.
handfixes.spec_encode_followup: Real fix is a method-aware gen_governance (classify from pp:method). Tracked in project_gen_governance_misses_verbless_writes / project_governance_rewrite_union_not_replace.

handfixes.summary: doctor probes a real GET endpoint with the real credential and refuses to dial a placeholder base_url, instead of calling any HTTP response 'reachable' and never checking the credential
handfixes.why: `doctor` is the command every SKILL, guide and docs page tells an operator to run to confirm the connector works, and it could not tell a working install from a broken one. It called any HTTP response to `GET /` "reachable" and rendered it green, so a base_url aimed at the vendor's web UI (where every API path 404s) and a token rejected with 401 on every call both produced an all-green report. On this connector family it also never probed the credential at all: it printed "present, not verified" and left the operator to guess. The mirror defect: a connector whose shipped base_url default is a placeholder dialled the placeholder host, and the DNS failure rendered as "FAIL API: unreachable" - telling a correctly-credentialled operator they were broken without naming the one variable that would fix it. Several placeholder hosts resolve through live wildcard DNS and answer real HTTP, so dialling one produced a confident green verdict against a stranger's server. Measured and gated by tools/maintainer/check_doctor_truth.py. See issue #282.

handfixes.summary: every operator credential this connector reads is declared on all three install channels: manifest.json (.mcpb), server.json (MCP Registry) and mcp-install.md (manual install)
handfixes.why: Issue #282 ('three live-verified connectors prompt for the wrong credentials'). A connector is installed through THREE independent channels that each carry their own copy of the credential list: manifest.json server.mcp_config.env (what the .mcpb bundle hands Claude Desktop, which has no shell profile, no config.toml and no export - so an undeclared variable is a variable nobody is ever asked for), server.json environmentVariables (the MCP Registry publish channel), and mcp-install.md's copy-paste JSON blocks plus its remote launch line (the manual path, which never touches the bundle at all). The fleet-wide audit found 60 of 65 connectors under-declaring 122 operator-facing variables in the manifest, 61 of 65 mcp-install.md pages omitting 125, and hudu's server.json missing the base URL its manifest marks required. For gradient the manifest gained: GRADIENT_BASE_URL, GRADIENT_PARTNER_API_KEY, GRADIENT_VENDOR_API_KEY. server.json gained: GRADIENT_BASE_URL, GRADIENT_PARTNER_API_KEY, GRADIENT_VENDOR_API_KEY. mcp-install.md's env blocks gained: GRADIENT_BASE_URL, GRADIENT_PARTNER_API_KEY, GRADIENT_VENDOR_API_KEY. manifest.json, server.json and mcp-install.md are ALL regenerated by /msp-skills-publish on an UPDATE or re-onboard, so without this ledger a regeneration silently drops every declaration and CI stays green (check_env_schema.py is wired --warn). The asserts below name the specific credentials, not a count, so dropping one and adding another cannot cancel out.
handfixes.spec_encode_followup: cli-printing-press should emit server.mcp_config.env, the matching user_config prompts, server.json environmentVariables and mcp-install.md's env blocks from ONE declaration of the connector's operator-facing environment, so the three channels cannot be generated out of step. Until then check_env_schema.py compares all three and this ledger pins them.
